cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.

mechanism: A uses expert meal timing and preparation distinctions to demand that a partner prioritise their shared dinner over a promotion opportunity instead of deferring the connection again.
confusable: D73 asks presence as connection proof; D82 explicitly opposes a competing work opportunity and asks this relationship chosen first.
comparison: Vow alternative accepts limited work cover; dumpling alternative rejects another postponement after a named anniversary precedent.
seedUse: Mothers dumplings, networking director, freezing and anniversary postponement derive from D82-b; S03 adds ready-to-serve versus stored-food corrections.
